reviews.text: Our little kitty, 15, became acutely ill, we got great help and a diagnostic job at Anicura Smestad. 10/10 to veterinarian Cathinka
Very happy with the staff, very good service and you are made to feel welcome. We got vet Camilla, very nice lady :) We felt safe and they took good care of my dog.
Here you will be welcomed with care and understanding😊
Nice and skilled animal caretakers and veterinarians. Very satisfied

I have been using AniCura Smestad for the last 4 years, I have moved away but still refuse to change vet because of how happy I am with the quality of care and friendliness of the staff here. They care about what they do and they ensure you are well informed at all times.

I would wholeheartedly recommend bringing your animal here, you won’t regret it.
Thank you for giving us feedback. We are very happy that you are satisfied!
The best people, both at the reception and in the medical treatment
Very nice and professional staff
Very satisfied. Nice and knowledgeable staff, and very professional!
Thank you so much for taking the time to give us a review. It means a lot to us.

AniCura Animal Hospital Oslo is a very professional clinic with a clear and well-organized system. The vets and staff explain everything step by step and make sure you understand the treatment plan. As a careful and detail-oriented pet owner, I really appreciate how seriously they take both me and my animal. I feel safe bringing my cat here and can warmly recommend this hospital.

Fantastic staff with good expertise🙏 Really well received and first-class treatment by Truls 🐕 Good prices!
Definitely recommended!
We love you all 😁 …

Been here almost 10 times in total, if not more. Always an equally fantastic experience! My dog ​​has had both knees operated on by Silvia Jauernig. Absolutely stunned by her dedication and follow-up. We have also been to Kari-Anne, several of the veterinarians, met almost all of the animal caretakers, clinic assistants and receptionists. I have truly never experienced service like this. I am so incredibly grateful and would recommend everyone to come here. Thank you so much!!

They were so kind and helpful. Having an emergency with my cat was so stressful. They were able to make an appointment asap, diagnose and fix her problem right away. Anicura staff has proven to always be extremely kind at any location I've been to.

A very nice and supportive team! They took the time to listen to you and did a complete check up to find the reason why my cat was not eating. After we brought my cat back home, we followed up. Thanks again for taking such good care of us both.

I am very disappointed with AniCura Oslo Veterinary Hospital. I was twice confirmed by phone that it was time for a CT scan of my dog, Trulte, but when we showed up we were told that it could not be done – neither CT nor rhinoscopy.

The vet himself said that he did not think Trulte had nose mites, and that the medication was therefore unlikely to help, but still recommended that we continue with it and wrote it in the medical record: “For now, no further treatment beyond Milbemax. If the symptoms do not return for CT and rhinoscopy? will be referred to internal medicine.” Such a formulation, with a question mark in the middle of the sentence, appears both unclear and contradictory.

At the reception I was told that I would have to call myself if the medication did not work, but the very next day I was called for a CT appointment. Then I would have had to see another vet to have both CT and rhinoscopy done. I paid 2,516 NOK for an hour that was in practice completely wasted.

Unclear medical records, conflicting messages and poor internal communication led to unnecessary stress and delayed treatment. I will not be using this clinic again and cannot recommend them further.

Saved our dogs life, very quick response great costumer service, genuine care and love for pets and very professional!
Definitely hard working and long opening hours, thank you to the two young ladies for saving my dog 🐕 …

My dog ​​had surgery at AniCura recently, with Peder Haaland.
Incredibly skilled veterinarians, the surgery was successful and I would recommend both Peder and AniCura to anyone who has a dog struggling with lameness.
Easy to get in touch with them both by phone and email.

Disappointing experience at AniCura Animal Hospital.

I arrived early, checked in, and sat in the large, empty waiting room with my cat. No one told me where to sit. Shortly after I sat down, a woman came into the building in outerwear, clearly not in uniform, and without introducing herself, she rather brusquely asked me to move to the small cat waiting room, which no one had mentioned earlier. It had only two uncomfortable chairs, while the main room was completely empty.

I waited over 30 minutes after my appointment without any information. When I asked at the front desk, I was only told that “the vet might be busy.” Eventually the vet came out, apologized profusely, and said she didn’t know I had come. She was professional, pleasant, and helpful throughout the entire hour.

When I was about to pay, a friendly employee started to help me. Then the same receptionist from earlier came in, interrupted, and insisted on taking over. She asked what insurance I had and immediately said I would have to pay for everything myself. When I asked again to be sure, she repeated it — until a colleague shouted from the back room that I could use my insurance, just not via direct billing. The receptionist smiled sarcastically and said, “This is the last time we’ll do this for you.” I still don’t understand what she meant by “this” — all I got was an invoice that I was supposed to send to the insurance company myself.

The vet was very good, but poor communication and unprofessional behavior from the front desk ruined the impression. This was the worst customer experience I’ve ever had at a service-oriented place. I will never return to this clinic, not even for a follow-up visit, and I would strongly advise others not to visit this animal hospital based on my experience.

I will be filing a formal complaint with the clinic.

Avoid these! They can't even get us an appointment for our sick cat within 8 days of the referral! Despite several inquiries, they are completely helpless in organizing themselves to find a date and place for a very sick cat with severe neurological consequences! Total amateurs. They probably have other priorities than animal care and the well-being of the animals!
Super

Had to bring in my cat on a Sunday after having been bitten in a fight with an unknown cat. Our cat had multiple bite wounds which had to be disinfected under general anesthesia. The vet informed us beforehand that this would cost in excess of 15000 NOK. We were a bit shocked, and then it was offered to clean the wounds without anesthesia for 5000 NOK, which we accepted. Upon coming home from the vet I noticed they had missed two additional bite wounds which I then had to clean and disinfect myself. Very expensive and a poorly executed job. Go to your local vet.

Found a grape stalk in my dogs beard at midnight when our local vet and most others were closed. I am a foreign student, who cannot afford a false alarm night visit to the vets 1 hour away (don't have a car) - so read up as much as possible to know what to do, though the internet only made me more concerned and anxious. I called this hospitals 24hr phoneline, as I cannot handle the anxiety of the situation myself anymore. The young lady (sorry i wish i asked your name) who picked up the phone and calmed  me down, reassured me - thank you so much. truly. would rate 6 stars if i could.
A little wait, but very good service from highly competent staff.

Surgeon Sylvia is fantastic, oozing with knowledge and experience. The radiographer and the other staff are empathetic, considerate and take the time to listen and answer questions. Thank you for being so good ❤️ regards from me and Selma

Got quick and good help when our dog had thrown up a lot, the woman who was at work was kind, understanding and took her time😊 it's nice when professionals encourage people to feel free to call back if they have questions 👍🏼 It's expensive to go to the vet, but that's why you have good insurance 😊 …
Very expensive

A HUGE THANK YOU to you animal caretakers, all the vets (who took such wonderful care of/treated my dog ​​Diesel Doris from day one and in the years that followed) and of course you wonderfully supportive and accommodating "receptionists/caretakers", for all the support and help you gave her/us in the years you looked after her❤️‍🩹🐶❤️ You were:worth every penny🙏🏻❣️ I wish we had discovered you much sooner, but she was almost 15 years old, and this is largely due to your care, professional expertise and the "little" extra you give our animals🙏🏻 Doris walked in that door hesitantly only the first time (at other vets we've been to, she's almost backed out, trembled and jumped right into my lap). But after her first visit to you, where her first meeting was with a wonderfully welcoming veterinarian, Peder🥰 So it was no problem to come to visit you (Peder who just by seeing the dog move a few meters gave us the answer/solution to a lameness, we had tried to investigate for 2-3 years without success, and surgery x 2 shoulders = lame-free dog)❤️‍🩹🐶🙏🏻❤️ And with specialists in most things, you became a regular veterinarian from that day❤️🙏🏻🐶🙏🏻❤️ I can continue to brag about you to the skies, something I do to other pet owners every now and then, you should know, but I hope from what is written here now (and as I have said/brag to you during our visits), that you understand how safe and good it has been to come to you🙏🏻 Doris is deeply missed, but lives on so many good memories and the fact that she actually got so old❣️I am pretty sure this had a lot to do with the good cooperation with the pet owners too👌🏻. Because your vets actually listen to us animal owners too (we who know these 4-legged precious best friends of ours, in my case my "child" in a different way/areas, that they don't see in everyday life). This is a good recipe I think (my opinion), in many cases a good and longer life for some animals❤️‍🩹❤️ Thank you for this for me/us, and thank you very much for your message of condolence (even though we were recently at Anicura Jeløy because of a specialist for the diagnosis she had then, I got that message shortly after, it made an impression❤️)❣️ Maybe one day I will be able to come by and thank you in person🙏🏻❤️ Best wishes and big hugs to you all🥰
Dr Anna treated our dog very well and was very informative and friendly. Highly recommend.
We took a friend's dog in because he vomited at home. The nurses were very quick and attentive. Thank you so much; it turned out to be some small stones he had swallowed.

We came in with our kitty who was very unwell, on a Sunday. Kitty became acutely ill all of a sudden and collapsed. We were very well received and treated with care and empathy. However, I think it took too long, in an emergency situation, for the check-in and for Kitty to be examined by a vet. It ended up that Kitty died in my arms before she could be released without suffering, she was too sick. The vet was very empathetic and did the best she could in a cruel situation. I wish the check-in had not been so slow.
